# Who Is Allowed to Interpret a Dead Designer’s Codes? — motion and channel evidence manifest

Version 2.0 · RN Collins · 7 September 2026

## Reels / TikTok / Shorts
### 0–8s — OBJ-155989
Voiceover: The dual designer attribution makes succession visible as an evidence question: house continuity does not erase uncertainty about individual authorship.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Brooklyn Museum Costume Collection at The Metropolitan Museum of Art, Gift of the Brooklyn Museum, 2009; Gift of Mrs. C. Oliver Iselin, 1961

Rights: Public Domain / Met Open Access

### 8–16s — CN02-DIAGRAM-1
Voiceover: 01 · CLAIM — What authority is being asserted?. Name the verb: preserve, exhibit, authenticate, reproduce, license, design, speak for, teach, sell, or change. Avoid the totalizing phrase “protect the legacy.”

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 16–24s — CN02-DIAGRAM-2
Voiceover: 02 · RECORD — What supports that claim?. Attach corporate appointment, trademark record, license, will, probate order, copyright chain, collection agreement, employment record, oral history, craft evidence, or community protocol as appropriate.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 24–32s — CN02-DIAGRAM-3
Voiceover: 03 · LIMIT — Where does the authority stop?. A museum accession does not appoint a house successor; inherited copyright does not confer craft mastery; corporate title does not erase community memory; cultural legitimacy does not itself transfer a registered asset.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 32–40s — CN02-DIAGRAM-4
Voiceover: 04 · CONTEST — How can interpretation be challenged and revised?. Publish sources, acknowledge gaps, credit carriers, invite corrections, document dissent, and schedule periodic review rather than presenting succession as final truth.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 40–48s — S63
Voiceover: 17 U.S.C. § 201 — Ownership of copyright is retained as evidence, education, reporting or rights context.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: U.S. Copyright Office

Rights: Official statutory text; quote narrowly and link. Subsections (d) and (e) address transfer by law, will, or intestacy.
